_comment: Who voices what (ElevenLabs). tools/generate_voices.py reads this; the game only reads the generated clips. Guards and Niro use eleven_v3 so the [audio tags] in 'delivery' carry the emotion; subtitles never show the tags. Swap any voice_id for one from the ElevenLabs Voice Library and re-run: only changed lines regenerate.

niro.name: Niro (designed voice, preview 3)
niro.design_brief: A man in his early thirties, an educated tower physician who has completely lost it: unhinged, theatrical and unpredictable. Soft bedside whisper that snaps into manic, giggling speed, cracked high laughter, then dead flat stillness. Warm and terrifying at once, like he loves you and has already decided what to cut out of you. Raspy, breathy, wild. British.
niro.design_sample: Can you hear me? Good. [giggles] I hate this thing too, it makes me sound like them. [whispers] Come back to the chair, Miro. [laughs maniacally] I'll make it quick! [suddenly calm] I always do.
